en.title: Optimal Transfer
en.description:
Capacities are in ascending order and distinct. A direct connection between any two servers costs the difference of their capacities, and connecting to the nearest server costs 1. Answer 0-based queries.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: n,q≤200000, capacity≤10^9, and each server's nearest server is unique.
en.output: Output the minimum connection cost for each query in order.
en.explanation: For each adjacent edge in each direction, take the nearest-shortcut cost 1 or the direct capacity difference, and answer queries with per-direction prefix sums.
